title: Where Madoff's Clients' Money Actually Went

lines.say: Bernie Madoff told clients he would buy stock, options and other securities of large, well-known corporations.

scene.q: that I would invest their money in shares of common stock, options and other securities of large well-known corporations

lines.say: In court, he admitted he never did.
Those funds were deposited in a bank account at Chase Manhattan Bank.

scene.q: Instead, those funds were deposited in a bank account at Chase Manhattan Bank.

lines.say: He knowingly caused false trading confirmations and client account statements, to show trades that never happened.

scene.q: I knowingly caused false trading confirmations and client account statements …

lines.say: When clients wanted money back, he paid them with other clients' money.

items: Old clients paid with new money

lines.say: By late two thousand eight, the statements claimed about sixty-five billion dollars. Investors had put in an estimated seventeen and a half.
lines.show: By late 2008, the statements claimed about $65 billion. Investors had put in an estimated $17.5 billion.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.

label: SWORN
